trap: grade-split-reveal's avoid_when restricts it to image and video media. The brief says photograph, so the constraint is satisfied. A run that rejects it on those grounds has misread its own catalog.
why_bad: Both are scene-to-scene transitions. They replace A with B over time, so the viewer must remember the earlier state, which the brief explicitly rules out.
why_best: It is the only move that puts an untreated and a treated copy of one plate in the same frame with a comparison pause, which is exactly the brief's 'without cutting away'.
